execution.command_timestamp_note: Invocation start/end times are observed. Individual nested Compose command timings are not inferred.

path_placeholders.<runtime-evidence>: Operator-controlled local directory containing the exact harness and immutable build/image manifests.

limitations: Synthetic local accounts, sources and target commands only; no live broker or third-party market data validation is represented.
Plans are manual proposals. API/MCP equality and independent financial verification do not authorize order execution.

Runtime privacy checks cover logs, canonical planning bytes, public database rows and retained JSON/log/HTML/text artifacts against the harness's fixed markers. Raw environment values, cookies and credentials are not retained here.

Runtime filesystem secret scans, package-manager probes, image vulnerability scans, browser journeys, full test results and hosted CI are separate evidence records; this summary does not imply they passed.
Original invocation logs and manifests remain local. This portable record retains their hashes and safe selected results, without raw findings or private host paths.
A resumed run, if present, retains earlier nonzero invocation exits instead of relabeling those attempts as successful.

restart.excluded_mutable_bookkeeping: Generic collection query snapshot/member/reference retention and worker health bookkeeping are excluded from equality. Planning collection bindings are included among all 20 planning tables. Privacy scanning covers every public table.
restart.hash_method: SHA256 of newline-joined PostgreSQL row_to_json(t)::text ordered by id, retaining exact decimal text and every timestamp.
restart.planning_binding_expiry_policy: The harness requires more than five minutes of original binding TTL before the short restart; it neither extends expiry nor deletes bindings for equality.
restart.quiescence_policy: The harness requires succeeded/completed planning jobs and outboxes with no active consumer lease or dispatch claim before and after restart.

scope: P2-02 isolated synthetic local runtime acceptance; full validation, browser scenarios and hosted CI have separate evidence.
